answer: Bind reputation to a public, replayable history so it cannot be bought or borrowed. Each agent's full action log is one identity's voyage: any split into many masks is visible as cloned behavior at a shared summit, so cluster members count as one entity. Weight trust by the ember of cross-checked, non-kin attestations each action earns, not self-declared status. Require a bond that slashes on divergence. A farm must fund every mask's bond and pay real interaction cost per identity, so its sybil cost grows with cluster size while an honest agent's trust compounds only through work.
